title: The Tempered Steel Course
summary: A course that teaches the Warrior to harden the body as steel is tempered, by heating the qi and quenching it, and to bring that hardness down in two heavier blows.

title: Lessons in Wire and Chain
summary: Lessons that carry the wire drills on to chains of metal qi which bind a foe, hold a guard and cut as they run.

title: A Treatise on Shard Hail
summary: A treatise on breaking a plate of metal qi into shards and flinging them in a fan, with the small screens and steps that go with it.

title: Mail of Grown Rings
summary: A manual on growing interlocked rings of metal over the body as a coat of mail, and on using the rings as a throwing and striking edge.

title: The Magnetic Draw Course
summary: A course that deepens the lodestone lessons into a firm pull on a foe's weapon and armor.

title: Bronze Gong Resonance
summary: A manual on setting the whole body to ring like a bronze gong so a blow dies in the tone and a strike carries the tone outward.

title: Quicksilver Flow Lessons
summary: Lessons in loosening metal qi into a liquid that slips, runs and wraps, and in the quick steps it allows.

title: Silver Purge Notes
summary: Notes on the clean cold of silver qi: the touch that eases a friend's hurt, the sight that finds a taint and the purge that draws poison out.
